exam.title: Certified Kubernetes Administrator
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal certification prerequisite. Build practical Linux, networking, container, YAML and Kubernetes evidence: kubeadm/HA/lifecycle/etcd, RBAC/extensions/operators, controllers/admission/scheduling, Service/DNS/policy/Ingress/Gateway paths, CSI storage, and node/control-plane/workload/network/storage troubleshooting on disposable clusters. Verify the official Kubernetes version immediately before study and scheduling.

review.notes: All five current Kubernetes v1.35 domains are mapped through reconciliation, packet/storage paths and an evidence-led troubleshooting ladder, with three scenarios, eight safe labs and 42 original checks. All ten guide URLs are cataloged: eight reachable and O'Reilly plus Udemy automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The August 26 v1.37 release creates a September 23–October 21 recheck window without moving the live v1.35 baseline, and the retired ingress-nginx controller is explicitly distinguished from the stable Ingress API objective. No proprietary simulator tasks, course labs or recalled exam tasks are used.

findings.title: Watch window is not an announced exam-version transition
findings.evidence: Livepage continues to name v1.35; no concrete exam switch date observed.
findings.recommendation: Retain version/recheck window but change unsupported scheduled flag to none-announced.
findings.resolution: Retain version/recheck window but change unsupported scheduled flag to none-announced.

findings.title: Unready addresses may remain in EndpointSlices
findings.evidence: Conditions distinguish readiness,serving and termination; an address listing alone does not establish eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Correct readiness and endpoint answers, service diagnosis and integrated scenario; add conditional interpretation.
findings.resolution: Correct readiness and endpoint answers, service diagnosis and integrated scenario; add conditional interpretation.

findings.title: PDB does not constrain Deployment rolling updates
findings.evidence: Budgets govern cooperating eviction, while workload strategy controls rollout; rollout unavailability still counts.
findings.recommendation: Remove PDB as a direct rollout-blocker inference, add lifecycle distinction and stronger lab/answer.
findings.resolution: Remove PDB as a direct rollout-blocker inference, add lifecycle distinction and stronger lab/answer.

findings.title: PDB percentage rounding differs from Deployment maxUnavailable
findings.evidence: PDB percentage fields round up, while Deployment maxUnavailable rounds down.
findings.recommendation: Explain original seven-replica30percent case and real-status/capacity limits.
findings.resolution: Explain original seven-replica30percent case and real-status/capacity limits.

findings.title: Successful rendering cannot establish a working Service
findings.evidence: Generators change names/references; rendering is local composition without API/runtime checks.
findings.recommendation: Publish and execute original22-check exercise, including a selector error that successfully renders.
findings.resolution: Publish and execute original22-check exercise, including a selector error that successfully renders.

findings.title: Configuration consumption determines refresh behavior
findings.evidence: Projected files eventually update; env needs restart and subPath does not receive ConfigMap updates.
findings.recommendation: Teach API bytes/mount/application distinction and proposed refresh lab.
findings.resolution: Teach API bytes/mount/application distinction and proposed refresh lab.

findings.title: Backend reference permission differs from Gateway route attachment
findings.evidence: Cross-namespace backend references need destination-side permission distinct from listener attachment.
findings.recommendation: Teach both relationships and independently failed/allowed live-lab evidence, with installed API version limits.
findings.resolution: Teach both relationships and independently failed/allowed live-lab evidence, with installed API version limits.

findings.title: RWO does not mean one Pod
findings.evidence: RWO allows single-node use including multiple Pods; supported RWOP constrains one Pod.
findings.recommendation: Add scope distinction and answer without claiming application locking or runtime validation.
findings.resolution: Add scope distinction and answer without claiming application locking or runtime validation.

findings.title: Bypassing scheduler can strand delayed binding
findings.evidence: nodeName bypasses scheduler participation required by WaitForFirstConsumer.
findings.recommendation: Add scheduling/claim diagnosis and inherited-versus-manual reclaim-policy evidence.
findings.resolution: Add scheduling/claim diagnosis and inherited-versus-manual reclaim-policy evidence.

findings.title: Older etcd revisions can confuse Kubernetes watchers after restore
findings.evidence: The recovery guide recommends revision bump plus mark-compacted for Kubernetes caches.
findings.recommendation: Add version-specific recovery planning, no universal bump constant and no executed restore claim.
findings.resolution: Add version-specific recovery planning, no universal bump constant and no executed restore claim.
